# lakekeeper_effective_tags (Data Source)

The `lakekeeper_effective_tags` data source retrieves the resolved effective tags on a Lakekeeper object, including tags inherited from ancestor namespaces and the parent warehouse.

~> **Preview:** Governance tags are a **preview** feature in Lakekeeper and may change in future releases.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/tag)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lakekeeper_effective_tags" "table" {
  warehouse_id = "261bd4e4-5c57-4707-96ad-44128f9038c0"
  target_type  = "table"
  target_id    = "37cf8760-5092-4d5d-8b29-a6b46a45f067"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `target_type` (String) Target kind: `warehouse`, `namespace`, `table`, `view`, `generic-table`, or `column`.
- `warehouse_id` (String) The UUID of the warehouse.

### Optional

- `column_name` (String) The column name. Required when `target_type` is `column`.
- `target_id` (String) The UUID of the target object (`namespace_id`, `table_id`, `view_id`, or `generic_table_id`). Required when `target_type` is not `warehouse` (for `column`, set this to the `table_id`).

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes List) Resolved effective tags on the target. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the supplying attachment was created.
- `inherited_from_namespace_id` (String) Ancestor namespace UUID if inherited from a namespace.
- `inherited_from_type` (String) Ancestor kind (`warehouse` or `namespace`) if inherited; null if attached directly.
- `inherited_from_warehouse_id` (String) Ancestor warehouse UUID if inherited.
- `name` (String) Name of the tag definition.
- `source` (String) How the supplying attachment was produced.
- `tag_definition_id` (String) UUID of the tag definition.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the supplying attachment was last updated.
- `value` (String) Tag value, if set.
